snippet.title: The Profaned | Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
#gametrailer #indiegame #horrorgame 

Wishlist On Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4535890

The Profaned is an anomaly-hunting horror game developed by No Man Games.
Set within a forsaken, haunted church, the game offers a unique twist on the traditional anomaly-hunt formula, delivering a tense and atmospheric experience unlike anything you've seen before.
